items.title: PPL reports a 31.8GW Pennsylvania data-center pipeline and advances Invitium generation sites
items.summary: PPL reported 31.8GW of Pennsylvania data-center projects in advanced planning, over 11GW under signed electric-service agreements and more than 6.5GW under construction. Its 51%-owned Invitium venture has land capable of 8-14GW of generation, but will not begin construction or make material commitments before signing risk-protected energy supply agreements.

items.title: AI chip vendor Cambricon reports H1 2026 revenue of RMB5.996 billion, led by its cloud product line
items.summary: Cambricon reported H1 revenue of RMB5.996 billion, up 108.13% year over year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB2.311 billion, up 122.61%. Cloud-line revenue was RMB5.994 billion; R&D expense was RMB702 million, up 29.63%.

items.title: DRAM and memory-module vendor Biwin's subsidiary seeks up to RMB600 million for wafer-level chip packaging
items.summary: Biwin's controlled subsidiary Guangdong Xincheng Hanqi plans to raise up to RMB600 million at a RMB2.0 billion pre-money valuation for wafer-level advanced packaging. Outside investors are not final; Biwin would retain at least 52.5186% and the transaction includes potential repurchase obligations.

items.title: Data-center cooling vendor Yimikang discloses RMB171.9 million lawsuit and RMB169.7 million of frozen funds
items.summary: Yimikang and a subsidiary are defendants in a creditor subrogation dispute involving RMB171.921 million. A court froze RMB169.663 million, including RMB165 million of structured deposits bought with temporarily idle offering proceeds; the case has been accepted but not heard and the earnings impact is uncertain.

items.title: Amazon registers three Pecos County data-center buildings with estimated construction costs of $300 million each
items.source_name: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
items.summary: Texas accessibility records list Amazon Data Services as owner of three new 189,060-square-foot Pecos County data-center buildings, each with an estimated construction cost of $300 million and registered schedule of August-December 2026. The records do not disclose IT load, power contracts or operating capacity.

items.title: Firebird launches an AI factory in Armenia and sets a 300MW end-2027 deployment plan
items.summary: NVIDIA said Firebird launched an operational AI factory in Hrazdan after a six-month delivery cycle. Firebird separately plans more than 70,000 Blackwell and Rubin GPUs and 300MW in Armenia by end-2027, plus an approximately 2GW multi-market roadmap; those are future plans, not current operating capacity.

items.title: New Amazon Data Center Stokes Worry It Would Be the Most Polluting Power Plant in the U.S.
items.summary: The New York Times reported that Amazon confirmed it acquired a Pecos County site for a planned data center backed by new on-site generation. The report does not disclose Amazon data-center capacity, investment, delivery timing or final power-contract terms.
